name: FGSM-init Square with restarts
tagline: Random ±eps init, a few SPSA-style sign-grad refinements, then a Square-Attack patch loop with adaptive patch fraction and per-sample restart on stagnation.
init_recovers: Square Attack with margin loss and random init
diff_from_baseline: Versus the square baseline this writes the loop in-place rather than calling torchattacks.Square: it adds an upfront SPSA-style random direction warm-up, an active-set budget that prunes solved samples, and a per-sample stagnation-restart that re-initializes the perturbation when no improvement has been seen for many queries.

name: MWMA: margin-weighted SPSA momentum
tagline: Symmetric ±delta queries along a unit direction; updates with tanh-weighted momentum and a cosine schedule on (delta, lr) before sign-projecting onto the L_inf ball.
formula: $$ u \sim \mathcal N(0, I)/\|\cdot\|,\quad x_\pm = \Pi_{[0,1]}\!\big(x + \Pi_{B_\infty^\epsilon}(adv \pm \delta_t u - x)\big) $$ $$ d_\pm = \mathrm{margin}(x_\pm),\quad w = \tanh(5|d_- - d_+|),\quad \hat g = w\,\mathrm{sgn}(d_- - d_+)\,u $$ $$ m \leftarrow \beta m + (1-\beta)\hat g,\quad adv \leftarrow \Pi_{B_\infty^\epsilon}\!\big(adv + \eta_t\,\mathrm{sgn}(m)\big) $$
init_recovers: SPSA with constant step at progress=0
diff_from_baseline: Versus spsa, the gradient estimate uses only one direction per iteration (2 queries) but weights it by tanh of margin difference; it also adds Nesterov-style momentum and cosine schedules on both probe radius and step size, then sign-projects onto the L_inf ball as in PGD.

name: Square-style search with Adam-grad direction
tagline: Square-Attack patch updates whose direction blends sign(noise) with a per-coordinate Adam-on-margin gradient estimate; patch fraction decays exponentially.
init_recovers: Square Attack at gamma=0 (pure random sign in patch)
diff_from_baseline: Versus the square baseline this keeps patchwise updates but biases the patch sign by a per-pixel Adam estimate of the margin gradient (computed by finite-difference on accepted/rejected updates). Active-set pruning and exponential patch-fraction decay are added.

name: Active-set Square with restarts
tagline: Boundary FGSM init, 8 in-loop patch rounds with quadratic-decay patch fraction, then up to 3 chunked Square restarts on the unresolved active set, plus a final budget-burn.
diff_from_baseline: Versus the square baseline this wraps torchattacks.Square in an active-set loop: an in-line patch search resolves easy samples cheaply, then Square is invoked on the still-failing subset with smaller p_init each restart. Budget is explicitly tracked and reallocated to unresolved samples.

name: Targeted Square with random restarts
tagline: Square-style mask-and-replace with uniform random pixel values, but using a TARGETED margin (logit_target - logit_true); restarts on no-improvement bump exploration.

key_hyperparams.name: no_improve restart
key_hyperparams.role: trigger to bump p and re-target

init_recovers: Targeted Square Attack with constant p
diff_from_baseline: Versus square (untargeted, ±eps signs), this attack targets a random label and replaces selected pixels with uniform [0,1] values then projects to the L_inf ball. It uses a single global random Bernoulli mask (no spatially-contiguous patch) and re-targets every 50 stagnant steps.
